meaningBoundary: Selected native producer, reset, discontinuity reset and teardown joins for anonymous context records. Positive ordinary duration input, valid preexisting vector bounds and key membership, usable allocator contract and admitted storage remain conditional. Counter API meaning, callback scheduling, synchronization/lifetime under concurrency, allocator failure recovery, optional view semantics and live invocation unresolved. The normal local-DSP caller joins prepared channel count and rounded stride to engine descriptor admission: its local rate is fixed, internal frame capacity is bounded, scratch requests cover that capacity, and refresh rejects a different channel-format word. This is conditional on unchanged prepared fields, completing helpers and allocations supplying their requested capacity; standalone descriptor admission still has no upper stride bound. The chunk loop uses a 16-bit offset; higher uint16 primary maxima can wrap it. Primary-frame admission, external buffer extents, helper side effects, concurrent mutation and live reachability remain separate gaps. Full local buffer setup checks only main pointer nullness before requesting storage. It retains existing main pointers without proving capacity, attempts all trailing main allocations before their combined check, and does not roll back earlier successful allocations. An enabled optional request overwrites its pointer on every setup. Failure recovery, allocator capacity and ownership remain conditional. Refresh first rejects a primary frame maximum not divisible by four. This lowers the reachable wrap-domain to aligned uint16 maxima above the finite traversal bound; the alignment guard supplies no upper bound. Full original refresh checks after supported channel setup confirm conditional aligned wrap paths with downstream effects modeled. Host admission and live reachability remain unresolved.
